home_eyebrow: Free & open source · Built by dairy farmers
home_hero_lead: Free camera software that watches your barn day and night. The moment a cow is in heat or starts calving, a photo lands on your phone.
home_anim_label: Animation: the barn camera sees a cow in heat or a cow calving, the AI draws a box around it, and a message with a photo arrives on your phone.
home_anim_heat_body: Mounting seen on camera 3. Check the photo and the clip.
home_anim_calving_body: Water bag and legs visible in the calving pen.
home_how_title: From barn camera to your phone
home_how_lead: No collars, no transponders, no subscription. A camera you may already have, a computer on the farm and your phone: that's all it takes.
home_how_1_desc: Any IP camera with an RTSP stream films your cows around the clock. Your cameras keep working as before; the software reads an extra stream.
home_how_2_desc: On your own computer, the AI Detector checks the images every few seconds for mounting behaviour or the stages of calving.
home_how_3_desc: As soon as the AI is sure enough, Telegram sends you a photo, a close-up and a short clip. You check the cow and make the call.
home_video_lead: A short walkthrough in a real barn: from the camera image to the first message on your phone.
home_video_placeholder: The video loads as you scroll down
home_tools_lead: Our vision models are trained on thousands of images from real barns. The AI Detector runs them on your own computer and sends the alerts.
home_install_title: Up and running in an afternoon
home_install_lead: You install everything yourself, and we explain every step with screenshots. Farmers in their fifties and sixties have done it too.
home_community_text: In the Telegram group and on Facebook, farmers help each other with cameras, settings and new ideas. Many improvements came straight from users.
install_route_title: Three steps to a working system
install_help_text: Stuck somewhere? Fellow farmers and the developers are happy to help.
project_cta_title: Ready to try it in your own barn?
project_cta_text: The software is free. You install it yourself, step by step, with our guide.
